g.text: Execution and verification; no reasoning agent.
Images or numerical results can finish without STEP.
No network, provider credentials, or Docker socket.
CPU / memory / process / output / time limits.
TRD-5-13: each agent has its own ACP session, container, and persistent mounts.
Private ACP / MCP data flows and agent handoffs pass through the application; see acp-turn.
Local file paths are session-local. Shared project assets move through scoped fetch / publication.
Only the orchestrator has container-control authority. Container removal retains session volumes.
TRD-21-28: CAD agent owns iteration; FreeCAD provides images, numerical checks, and optional exports.
Confirmed architecture direction with proposed implementation details; no deployed services implied.
